name: Nemu
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c145819]Nerura[/url] during her lifetime. A woman found alone in the rain with nowhere to go, after being abandoned by her boyfriend. Due to her difficult family environment, she has trouble communicating with others, but she's actually an extremely devoted person when it comes to matters of love.
